realGUI.construction: Each full arm64 CodeRim target was compiled with the same generated Xcode dependency objects, package identifier and release flags, with the independent checkout source root substituted. Only the controller/state sources and linked cursor routine differ. Both use copies of the same private application bundle template, ad-hoc signing and ephemeral profiles. Neither run accessed a personal profile or network.

focused.scope: Candidate and previous Rust path compared to released Swift, plus identical host optimization with the released Swift control-hover calculation. NSPanel is process-owned and not ordered on screen. System pointer and screen layout are not mutated.

limitations: Single local Apple Silicon screen; Intel target replayed under Rosetta. No physical multi-screen, live Dock move, or battery life experiment.

Synthetic event fixture uses extracted shipping cursor, routing and fold/tooltip grace work with supplied geometry and recording of pointing-hand intent. Whole idle GUI measurement observes a real folded product window.
Interval-specific process statistics have uncontrolled external system activity and do not establish a general CPU or battery percentage.
